stem: 涉及执法部门、金融情报机构和私营部门之间信息共享的公私合作伙伴关系(PPP)旨在:(选择两项.)

options.A: 建立关键信息的共同数据库,并与金融行动特别工作组(FATF)共享可疑活动的分析结果
options.B: 在金融情报机构与义务机构之间交换战略信息
options.C: 金融机构之间交换战略信息
options.D: 在公共机构与义务机构之间交换运营信息

stem_en: Public-private partnerships (PPPs) that involve the sharing of information between law enforcement authorities, Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs), and the private sector are established to: (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Create a common database of key information and share analysis of suspicious activities with FATF
options_en.B: Exchange strategic information between FIUs and obliged entities
options_en.C: Exchange strategic information between financial institutions
options_en.D: Exchange operational information between public authorities and obliged entities
